cards.name: Weakness splash potions from scratch (zero-capital bootstrap)
cards.source: videos/Z-V5gXSVTG0.txt, Camel27, uploaded 2026-06-13 (footage predates the 2026-06-02 update: blaze rods, obsidian and end crystals are bought on /shop)
cards.setup_time: About one in-game day plus one night of gathering: 56 brown mushrooms, a stack of sand, sugarcane (very scarce, 'where has all the sugarcane gone on this server'), iron for a bucket, one spider eye (roughly a dozen spiders killed for one drop), then gunpowder from creepers the next night.
cards.capital_required: $0 in money; started with two blaze rods ('without those we can make zero potions')
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: Not stated per hour. First two potions sold for 160,000 total; after 10 brewing stands and one order cycle 'we're up to $1.2 million'.

inputs.unit_price: 85,000 shown for 100 (about 850 each if that is the total)
not stated; 'blaze rods we can purchase on the shop'

outputs.unit_price: $50,000 each quoted; listing seen at 90,000; sold 2 at 80k (160,000); later batch listed at $38,000 each

cards.process: Gather brown mushrooms, sugar cane, one spider eye, sand for bottles, iron for a bucket. Craft fermented spider eye (sugar + spider eye + brown mushroom). Brew 3 water bottles with the fermented spider eye into weakness, add gunpowder to make splash (buyers want splash to cure zombie villagers). List each potion individually on /ah, undercutting the visible price (90k seen, listed at 80k). Use the first 160k to place /orders for fermented spider eyes (skipping the crafting chain) and 50 gunpowder, buy 9 more brewing stands, brew a large batch and list at $38,000 each until $1.2M, which funds the auto brewer.
tricks: Order fermented spider eyes directly on /orders instead of farming sugar, mushrooms and spider eyes: 'that gets rid of all of that process'
Splash form is what sells: 'people want to cure zombie villagers. Only issue is they need to be splash potions'
Undercut the visible listing: price seen 90,000, 'Let me sell for 80k', both sold instantly
Set a home at the brewing spot before going out to farm gunpowder (/sethome)
Bought 9 extra brewing stands as soon as money came in to parallelize brewing
Blaze rods bought from /shop at the time (no longer possible after 2026-06-02)
cards.risks: Early game deaths (no armor, no totem) while hunting spiders and creepers; spider eye drop is rare; weakness price later collapsed to 7,000 a bottle within the same video; 'too many people making weakness potions'.
cards.scalability: Manual brewing is throttled by brewing stand count and fermented spider eye supply on /orders; each potion is listed individually so AH slots (18 default now) cap parallel listings.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: unknown - potions still trade on /ah, but blaze rods were bought on /shop in this footage; after the update they must come from /orders or /ah (SlaySlasher 2026-08-05 says blaze rods became 'pretty expensive' after shop removal), and default AH slots are 18 instead of the 3 rows shown.
verification_items: /ah current price of splash weakness potion (50k / 80k / 38k / 37k / 25k / 7k were all seen in June 2026)
/orders price of fermented spider eye (implied ~850 each from '100 of those. 85,000')
/orders price of gunpowder (50 for 10k = 200 each)
Blaze rod / blaze powder price on /orders and /ah now that /shop is gone
Brewing stand price
quotes: six weakness potions, which at the moment are currently going for $50,000 each. That would be $300,000 in our back pocket
Oh, why is that 90,000? ... Let me sell for 80k. ... I've got 160,000 in two potions
we can craft an order for fermented spider eyes. ... Get 100 of those. 85,000. Okay, maybe 50 for now
We'll get 50 gunpowder. That's 10k as well
we'll sell these for $38,000 each. And now that we sold every single potion and we're up to $1.2 million

cards.name: Auto-brewer potion modules: invisibility, fire resistance, weakness listed on /ah
cards.source: videos/Z-V5gXSVTG0.txt, Camel27, uploaded 2026-06-13 (footage predates the 2026-06-02 update)
cards.setup_time: Dig a large hole underground with obsidian + end crystals, build one two-sided module (about 100,000 in materials, 20 hoppers is the expensive part). Total play time for the whole 0 to 100M run 'maybe less than 24 hours'. Modules added at $1.2M (first), $5M (second, fire res + invis), then a third and more for invis until 'all of these are set up for invis'.
cards.capital_required: About $1M target before building the first module; each module 'should only cost us maybe a 100,000'; glass order 1,000 = 400k; restocking all machines once dropped balance from ~25M to $23M (about 2M of inputs).
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: Peak: $25M in 2 hours 21 minutes (25M to 50M) = about 10.6M/hr. First 25M took about 4.5 hours 'not at full efficiency'. 5.67M to 7M in 6 min 12 s. Final 99M to 100M in about 11 minutes while supply-limited. About 6,750 potions sold for the $100M total (154 pages of AH sales).
cards.claimed_profit_per_hour: Not stated; input restock was roughly 2M per full refill against tens of millions of sales, so margin is very high; invis at 9.9k 'seems very low for the price of ingredients'.

inputs.qty: 2 stacks per invis fill; 1 in the blaze powder slot
a few stacks per fire res fill
a few stacks / 3 stacks per fill

outputs.item: splash potion of fire resistance 8 min

outputs.unit_price: $10,000 -> listed 9.9K; later listed $19,000; 'can be worth like 40,000' then undercut to 38 and down; 7.5k at the low

cards.process: Dig a pit with end crystals on obsidian. Each module has two sides; each side is a brewing-stand line fed by a dispenser of glass bottles (water), a dropper/hopper chain for ingredients in brew order (fire res: nether wart, magma cream, redstone, gunpowder; invis: nether wart, golden carrot, fermented spider eye, redstone, gunpowder; weakness: fermented spider eye, gunpowder), blaze powder in the stand, about 20 hoppers, and a lever that starts the cycle. Finished splash potions flow through hoppers into a shulker box. Redstone is added because a normal potion is 3 minutes and the 8 minute one is wanted. Operator refills dispensers, flicks the lever, pulls potions from the shulker and lists each one individually on /ah, keeping one row of 9 per potion type, then repeats. Inputs are bulk /orders; glass 1,000 at a time.
tricks: Keep the AH filled with one row (9 listings) each of fire res, weakness and invis at all times
Sell whichever potion type is priced highest right now: 'when the price is higher than invis, I normally just sell these ones' then 'wait for the invis potion prices to come back up'
Invisibility was the best seller and was instantly bought out, so every new module was set to invis; weakness dropped because 'too many people making weakness potions'
Fire res 'takes a while to brew and it's currently selling before I can even list the next potion' so build a second module rather than wait
Use redstone in the chain to get 8 minute potions (3 minute without)
Order glass in bulk on /orders (1,000 at a time at $42) since bottles are needed the whole run
Order fermented spider eyes rather than crafting them
Dig the pit with end crystals on obsidian bought from /shop (pre-update)
Machines occasionally jam: 'some of the times they mess up ... might be user error'
Someone buying everything at once ('this guy ... just made me, I think, $300,000') is the upside of many low listings
cards.risks: Price wars: 'each potion can be worth like 40,000 and then someone will see that go 38 and it'll go down and down' to 7.5k; 'the potion market is very populated'; people list at ridiculously low prices; input stockouts (fermented spider eyes ran out twice); machines misfire; listing each potion individually 'does hurt your fingers after a while'.
cards.scalability: Bounded by AH listing labor (one listing per potion, ~6,750 listings for 100M), AH slot count (3 rows of 9 shown pre-update, 18 default now), invis demand, and /orders supply of fermented spider eyes, golden carrots, glass. Module cost (~100k) is negligible so modules can be added freely; 'we're just about keeping up with demand'.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: yes with caveats - the machine and /ah demand are unaffected, but blaze rods, obsidian and end crystals were bought on /shop here and now must come from /orders or /ah at higher cost, and default AH slots fell from 25 to 18 which cuts the 'three rows' listing pattern to two.

cards.name: Selling custom-built bases to players (Smurfi)
cards.setup_time: Find a customer in chat, agree on everything, build from a schematic, then rebuild the whole thing on DonutSMP. Time not stated.
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: Not per hour. One base: agreed price 13 million dollars plus a 10 million dollar tip; creator says 'in total, I made 40 million dollars from one base' (the stated parts do not add to 40).

outputs.unit_price: 13M agreed + 10M tip ('40 million dollars from one base')

cards.process: Advertise in public chat until someone wants a custom base. Agree on scope and price first. Design/build with a schematic (mod) to speed up, then rebuild it block by block on DonutSMP since schematics cannot be pasted on the server. Send screenshots to the client, get paid via /pay.
tricks: Recruit customers from public chat: 'I went into chat and started looking for someone who wanted a custom base'
Agree everything before building
Use a schematic to make the building process way faster, then rebuild it on the server
Tips can exceed the agreed price (10M tip on 13M)
cards.risks: Non-payment/scam since there is no escrow; numbers in the video are inconsistent (13M + 10M described as 40M total).
cards.scalability: Limited by builder time and finding customers; no AH or order limits involved.
cards.still_valid_after_june_2026_update: yes - player-to-player service unaffected by shop/multiplier removal (video is from August 2026).
verification_items: Whether 13M + 10M or 40M is the real total (transcript inconsistent)
Going rate for commissioned builds in chat/Discord
quotes: There is a lot of ways to get rich in Donut SMP. Gambling, building farms, flipping items, or even scamming people
we agreed to pay me 13 million dollars. They also gave me a 10 million dollars tip. So, in total, I made 40 million dollars from one base

cards.name: Charcoal furnace array: order logs, smelt, /sell charcoal
cards.setup_time: Not stated; furnace bank with hoppers feeding logs from a drop chest and planks as fuel, output into chests (extra storage had to be added).
cards.capital_required: About 1.9 million for 13,000 logs at 150 each, plus a spruce planks order for fuel; plus a good pickaxe
cards.claimed_gross_per_hour: After about one hour: three chests of charcoal, /sell in batches of about 500k, balance 3.4 million; 'almost three mill in profit, maybe two mill ... for an hour'. Then AFK'd 'overnight for a couple of hours' and was at 28 mil on day two (together with cookies).
cards.claimed_profit_per_hour: 'almost three mill in profit, maybe two mill' for the first hour (from a 1.9M log order)

inputs.unit_price: market 145 each, he ordered at 150 (1.9 mil)

outputs.unit_price: /sell batches of ~500k each; total ~2.4M+ in first hour

cards.process: Place a buy order for 13,000 logs at 150 (market 145) and an order for spruce planks. Drop planks into the fuel input and logs into the log input; hoppers route them into a bank of furnaces; charcoal flows into output chests. After ~1 hour collect and /sell everything (each chest-sized batch about 500k). Rationale: after /shop removal blaze rods are expensive so charcoal became a demanded fuel and its base price makes this profitable.
tricks: Overpay the order slightly (150 vs 145) so it fills fast
Use cheap planks as fuel via a separate hopper line
Add extra output storage; the furnaces outran the chests
Run it overnight AFK
Thesis: 'after the removal of slash shop, blaze rods are actually pretty expensive. So charcoal has slowly been gaining more attention'
cards.risks: Needs AFK time ('I don't really think I have that much time to be AFKing this all day'); farm was raided and destroyed on day three; margin depends on log order price vs charcoal /sell price.
cards.scalability: Log supply on /orders, furnace count and hopper block limit, AFK time; /sell has no slot limit.

mechanics_facts.fact: Splash weakness potions are bought to cure zombie villagers; buyers want the splash form, so gunpowder is required.
Adding redstone in the brew chain turns a 3-minute potion into the 8-minute version that buyers want.
Auto brewer module: dispenser of bottles, hopper/dropper ingredient chain, ~20 hoppers, lever start, output into a shulker box; about 100,000 in materials.
Blaze rods, obsidian and end crystals were bought on /shop in the Camel27 footage (pre 2026-06-02 update).
AH potion category shows demand for invisibility, strength and fire resistance; invis was the best seller, fire res sold faster than weakness, weakness oversupplied.
Potions are listed one per AH slot; the creator listed in three rows of 9 (27 visible slots pre-update) and sold ~6,750 potions for 100M.
Potion prices decay by serial undercutting (40k -> 38k -> ... -> 7.5k) and recover later; sell the highest-priced type at the moment.
Buy orders on /orders can be created for crafted intermediates (fermented spider eyes) and bulk blocks (glass 1,000 at a time).
Sugar cane is scarce near spawn ('where has all the sugarcane gone on this server').
Ways to get rich listed: gambling, building farms, flipping items, scamming, selling bases.
Schematics speed up design but the base must be rebuilt by hand on DonutSMP.
/sell pays little for dirt (848 for a pile); stacks on /ah sold for 14k-15k.
Bone meal on a rose bush drops another rose bush (duplication); a rose bush crafts into two red dye; bone meal can be automated with a dispenser.
After the removal of /shop, blaze rods became expensive, which raised charcoal demand as fuel.
Charcoal is sold to the server with /sell in roughly 500k batches; an hour of a hopper-fed furnace bank filled ~3 chests.
Fortune does not work on wheat; cookies (2 wheat + 1 cocoa) have well-paid buy orders because nobody farms them.
Autocrafters are used to convert ordered sticks into ladders sold by the stack on /ah.
Bases and farms get raided; on day three his charcoal and cookie farms were destroyed.
Deserts are stripped because sand sells high on /orders; tall dry grass is bone-mealable and sheared, and can render invisible until right-clicked.
Silence armor trims can be duplicated and sold on /ah at 100k each.
Mining mud very fast causes ghost blocks; TNT is an alternative harvest method.
Withers can be killed quickly with end crystals in diamond armor; nether stars sell on /ah overnight.
A Bedrock alt account can AFK a farm; fish flowing into magma die and drop loot; pufferfish -> water breathing potions.
AH has a listing cap ('I have too many listed items'); listing whole shulkers of potions bypasses per-item slots.
Base sales are done half up front, half after handover, with a sign and removal of the seller's /home.
Reactor: most of the richest players gamble ('99% of players out of the richest players, they all gamble').
Loot drops: streamers place high-AH-value blocks underwater and TP viewers; some fake them with texture packs; 'dragging' delays are common.
Spawners have a storage GUI with a 'sell all' button.
Reactor: AFK-selling spawner drops was nerfed this season; people now use spawners for the items (bones); a skeleton spawner costs about $6 million (Aug 2026).
Spawners cannot be sold to the server; they are traded player to player or through Discord servers, with scam risk.
Hackers detect spawners ('spawner in the pie chart'); hide them in a 1x1 box at bedrock rather than a visible obsidian cube.
Chorus fruit teleport does not work on the nether roof, so traps are built there; entity cramming with ~900 minecarts is used as the kill mechanism.
TP auto plus a 'TPA for free loot' chat message brings victims; trappers keep a double chest of loot at the trap.
IRL trading gets you banned.
A drill at Y -53 for ~4 hours yielded 3 stacks + 42 diamond blocks + 6 diamonds worth 11 million; considered trash.

Shards (2025): 10 per player kill, 1 per minute in the AFK zone, Donut+ earns them anywhere, shard booster gives 4x (5,760/day); spent in /shard shop on spawners or keys; skeleton spawner resells best. AFK shards and crates were removed 2026-06-02/03.
Spawner storage accumulates 100k+ bones; emptying into a shulker loader too fast causes severe lag.
Bones from skeleton spawners are sold into /orders at about 175-177 each and large volume pushes the price down.
Skeleton spawners traded between players at 4.3-4.4M in July 2026 with 10,000 valued around 50 billion (5M each).

Safe-base kit: 50+ obsidian layers (~250k obsidian), note-block proximity alarm, stasis chamber auto-pull at 50 blocks, sculk sensors for overnight detection; 2 minutes to reach the center lets you shulker the spawners.
About 5,669 skeleton spawners produced 1.02 billion in 6.5 hours via bone orders (about 157M/hr).
